name: Propylamphetamine
summary: Propylamphetamine is a central nervous system psychostimulant and substituted amphetamine which was never marketed. It was first developed in the 1970s, mainly for research into the metabolism of, and as a comparison tool to, other amphetamines.

pharmacology.text: Propylamphetamine is inactive as a dopamine releasing agent in vitro and instead acts as a low-potency dopamine reuptake inhibitor with an IC50 of 1,013 nM.

uses.text: Propylamphetamine (code name PAL-424; also known as N-propylamphetamine or NPA) is a central nervous system psychostimulant and substituted amphetamine which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: Lengthening the group on amphetamine's nitrogen from methyl, as in methamphetamine, to propyl sharply changes how it works. In laboratory tests propylamphetamine no longer releases dopamine at all.
fact.zh: 把安非他命氮原子上的基團從甲基（甲基安非他命）延長為丙基，會大幅改變它的作用方式。在實驗室測試中，propylamphetamine 完全不會釋放多巴胺。
fact.zhHans: 把安非他命氮原子上的基团从甲基（甲基安非他命）延长为丙基，会大幅改变它的作用方式。在实验室测试中，propylamphetamine 完全不会释放多巴胺。
